Russia Launches Drone and Missile Attacks on Ukrainian Cities

Russia launched drone and missile attacks targeting Ukrainian cities including Kyiv and Kharkiv. The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) reported being informed of a drone strike on the cooling tower of the Kursk nuclear power plant in Russia, though it was not on fire despite being operational. The attacks occurred as Russian offensives in eastern Ukraine reportedly stalled, with Russia also striking border crossings into Poland and Moldova.
